purpose: Teach: アンダー/ハリケーン/レバー/セクハラ/ワープロ/メトロ/合気道/ダイヤル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アンダーシャツ忘れたな
lines.style: Quick, knowing smirk. Casual callout — she's caught him in something small and is enjoying it. Relaxed pace, almost playful bite.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ハリケーン映画好きだろ?桜
lines.en: You like those hurricane movies, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a question, slightly flustered but hiding it. Light curiosity on the surface, but there's an edge — he's turning it around on her. Faster delivery than expected.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、自販機のレバーで小銭引っかかったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you got your change stuck in the vending machine lever, didn't you?
lines.style: Knowing half-smile. She's drawing out the moment before the reveal. Measured, slightly conspiratorial — inviting him to remember what she's about to pin him with.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、セクハラ研修、受けたか?桜
lines.en: Did you actually sit through the sexual harassment training, Sakura?
lines.style: Turned tables — his voice lighter now, playing her game back at her. There's warmth underneath the deflection. Quick, almost singing the question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ワープロって知ってるか?
lines.en: Riku, do you even know what a word processor is?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity wrapped in light mockery. Eyebrow up. She's testing whether he's old enough to not know something that obsolete. Slight pause before the punchline lands.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、東京メトロで迷子になったろ?桜
lines.en: You got lost in the Tokyo Metro, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle teasing with real amusement. He's relaxed now, enjoying the back-and-forth. Warm laughter just underneath the words. Slightly slower, savoring it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、合気道部に入りたいんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you want to join the aikido club, don't you?
lines.style: This one lands differently — less deflection, more genuine curiosity. Her voice softens slightly. She knows this one matters to him. Open delivery, inviting honesty.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ダイヤルの古い電話、博物館で見たろ?桜
lines.en: You saw one of those old rotary phones at the museum, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter now. Close, almost conspiratorial whisper. He's matching her shift in tone — the teasing has warmed into something more real. Intimate delivery.
